verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim infrastructure access 'wherever your resources live, including Kubernetes clusters,' with auditable SSH/K8s/database access, subnet routers, and infra-as-code integrations, and community testimonials corroborate managing home k8s clusters and SSH access remotely. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of Kubernetes access (only a generic homelab testimonial), and no detailed K8s-operator documentation excerpt beyond marketing claims.
